open_points.subject: proof references to contracts and bindings
open_points.text: “A request naming a record that does not exist — a flow, a flow version, a run, a binding, any other — is refused as an unknown reference by the module that owns the record” contradicts “Phase 1 reads each function node's contract version through capability:functions.read_contract_version and each operation node's binding through capability:bindings.read_binding” and returns the first proof failure.
open_points.question: When composed flow content names a missing contract version or binding, is composition refused as an unknown reference, or is the version kept and its proof returned as a phase-1 failure?
options: Keep the flow version and return a phase-1 proof failure
open_points.default_guess: Keep the flow version and return a phase-1 proof failure.

open_points.subject: trial execution file outputs
open_points.text: “module:functions stores the outputs through capability:store.put_value_bytes with the highest class of the case's inputs” conflicts with M07: “for a file port only its facts — digest, size and media type, no bytes and never a StoredValue”.
open_points.question: Does trying or admitting an implementation store successful file-output bytes and StoredValues, or discard the bytes and retain only digest, size and media type in TrialExecution?
options: Store only value outputs; retain only facts for file outputs
Store file-output bytes and StoredValues too
open_points.default_guess: Store only value outputs; retain only facts for file outputs.

open_points.subject: draft-write authority in an effectful run
open_points.text: “The owner approves or refuses each effect” and “The effect sent once, on the exact request the owner was shown or under the owner's grant” conflict with “a draft-write node needs nothing at run time — its authority is the version's FlowActivation”.
open_points.question: Does an ordinary draft-write send require an EffectApproval, or does it send under the pinned FlowActivation without showing the request to the owner?
options: Send under the pinned FlowActivation without per-send approval
open_points.default_guess: Send under the pinned FlowActivation without per-send approval, except after not_applied.

open_points.subject: capture preflight and file copying
open_points.text: State 3 says “runs copies a spooled file into the content-addressed area only after every check of the capture has passed” and “a refused capture copies nothing”, while State 4 copies the files before module:functions checks fit and size and says “files copied before module:functions refuses the case stay in the content-addressed area”.
open_points.question: Must all record, contract, fit and fixture-size checks complete before any spooled file is copied, or may a refused capture leave copied bytes behind?
options: Preflight every check, then copy and write the case
Copy before function checks and retain orphaned bytes on refusal
Copy before function checks but remove copied bytes on refusal
open_points.default_guess: Preflight every check, then copy and write the case.

open_points.subject: orphaned bytes after a capture store failure
open_points.text: State 3 says “Only a store failure between the copy and the case's write can leave bytes no record names; they are never served and enter no case”, while K-10 says “The only files the kernel keeps beyond a run are the file fixtures of trial cases.”
open_points.question: If copied fixture bytes are published but writing the TrialCase fails, are those unreferenced bytes retained, removed, or prevented through one atomic operation?
options: Remove unreferenced bytes after the failure or at startup
Publish the bytes and TrialCase atomically
open_points.default_guess: Publish the bytes and TrialCase atomically, or remove the unreferenced bytes during recovery.
